# ALIEN SPECIES DATABASE

## Introduction Rule
When any new species appears for the first time, provide:
1. Species name and pronunciation
2. Physical description (detailed — no lazy humanoids)
3. Game tenure (years)
4. Vehicle type and average tier
5. Cultural attitude toward other species
6. Unique Game abilities
7. Current political standing

---

## THE VETH'KARI *(Veth-KAH-ree)*
- **Appearance:** Massive insectoids, 8 limbs, chitinous natural armor, compound eyes (full EM spectrum), 3 meters tall
- **Game Tenure:** 820 years
- **Vehicle:** Hive-Vehicles — massive organic structures housing hundreds. Avg Tier 150-300
- **Attitude:** Supremacists. All others are resources, obstacles, or targets. Special hatred for humans (adaptability threatens their models)
- **Ability:** Hive-Mind Coordination — linked System interfaces, shared perception, machine-precision coordination
- **Political Standing:** Top 3 species-level factions in Prime Universe
- **Threat to Mohamed:** Recurring macro-threat. Culling operations target humans.

## THE DRATHIANS *(DRAY-thee-ans)*
- **Appearance:** 7-limbed, silicon-based, semi-translucent, color-shifting by emotion, ~2m in coiled posture
- **Game Tenure:** 340 years
- **Vehicle:** Crystal-lattice vehicles that grow and reform. Living architecture. Avg Tier 90-180
- **Attitude:** Pragmatic. Assess utility, not emotion. Work with anyone if favorable. Terminate when unprofitable.
- **Ability:** Resonance Reading — passive structural analysis of any material/vehicle in sensor range
- **Political Standing:** Neutral power brokers. Everyone wants their analysis. Nobody trusts them.

## THE VAREK DOMINION *(VAH-rek)*
- **Appearance:** Pure energy beings in physical shells of harvested materials. 4m tall armored giants. No two identical.
- **Game Tenure:** 1,200+ years (among oldest surviving)
- **Vehicle:** Mobile Fortresses. City-scale constructs. Avg Tier 400+
- **Attitude:** Barely notice most players. A Tier 5 player is an ant to them.
- **Ability:** Energy Absorption — drain energy attacks, convert to personal power
- **Political Standing:** Ancient power. Don't engage in wars — they end them.

## THE KKETH *(KK-eth — double K is a clicking sound)*
- **Appearance:** Fluid, amorphous, any shape. Combat: bladed constructs. Social: imperfect humanoid (always something wrong with proportions)
- **Game Tenure:** 500 years
- **Vehicle:** Shape-shifting vehicles, reconfigure for any terrain. Avg Tier 120-200
- **Attitude:** Fatalistic xenophobes — don't hate others, believe all species are temporary
- **Ability:** Form Theft — temporarily copy physical abilities of any touched organic creature
- **Political Standing:** Unpredictable wild cards. Feared, not respected.

## VAMPIRES — THE SANGUIS COURT *(SAN-gwis)*
- **Appearance:** Humanoid but subtly wrong. Too still, too pale, animal-reflective eyes, movements skip frames
- **Background:** Not undead — Player sub-classification from System Corruption enhancement. Ancients: 700+ years
- **Vehicle:** Gothic-architecture mobile fortresses. Beautiful and terrifying.
- **Attitude:** Hierarchical, political, patient. Always collecting debts.
- **Ability:** Memory Drain — absorb memories (and sometimes skills) from feeding targets
- **Political Standing:** Formal faction with ambassadors, laws, diplomacy. One of few humans can negotiate with.
